name: Angel Clawd pixel mascot (print-scale transparent PNGs)
note: SUPERSEDED 2026-08-08: Gary reviewed the proof sheet and rejected this deterministic pixel-port look ('decent job, but I don't really like it'); the angel-clawd motif is now produced by gpt-image-2 via the framework provider adapter (see canon/entities/angel-clawd.json and canon/craft/pixel-mascot-medium-exception.json). This generator and its outputs stay on disk as history; do not install its outputs as deliverables. Original rationale follows. Pixel art prompted from an image model comes back mushy; this mascot is COMPUTED. The base rect geometry is a faithful port of the deterministic rectangles-only SVG in tastefulstories/src/app/story/Clawd.tsx (itself in the spirit of Claude Code's pixel mascot); the geometry is source material, not a knob, so it lives in code while every variation knob lives here in params. Downstream consumer: Gary's Anthropic-fan-art print-on-demand shirts ('Anthropic Mom' / 'Proud Mom - An Anthropic Evangelist'), which is why every output is transparent-ground at 3200px long edge and why the mono palettes exist (single-colour variants print cleanly on white and dark garments). Rasterized with rsvg-convert using shape-rendering=crispEdges, so rect edges are hard pixel edges with no anti-alias seams between abutting rects.

outputs.description: canonical: coral body, cream wings, floating pixel heart, wings spread; transparent, 3200px long edge
pixel halo above the head, coral body
halo AND floating heart together, coral body
checkered racing flag held at the right side stub, plus wings
no accessory, coral body, cream wings
wings raised higher, heart, coral body
wings raised, halo AND heart, coral body
wings raised, checkered flag, coral body
all-burnt-orange monochrome (#b0512e), eyes knocked out transparent with mono glints; for white shirts
crop-zoom of the load-bearing detail: glinted eyes, side stubs, inner wing scallops

assertions: every variant reads as the SAME critter: stepped coral (or mono) body, two pairs of dangling legs, mid-body side stubs, big glinted eyes, three-row scalloped wings growing from BEHIND the body
each variant is proofed on the ground it will actually print on: coral and burnt-orange on white, cream on a dark garment ground
the mono variants' knocked-out eyes read as eyes (transparent holes with a mono glint), not as a blob
the 1:1 crop tile from the 3200px master shows hard crisp pixel edges with no anti-alias mush and no seams between abutting rects
the flag is held at the side stub; the wings are never held and stay behind the body
no cream paper ground anywhere: every deliverable PNG is fully transparent outside the figure
